runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game tz_92 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --watch-switch 5 --watch-switch 7 --watch-switch 8 --watch-switch 22 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-fliptronic/tz-clock-test.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. The scenario holds public 22 released (coin door open) from power-up, leaves the fresh-NVRAM message loop with service Escape, walks the service menu with Enter and Up to T.16 CLOCK TEST (the 9.2 ROM inserts T.14 LAMP ROW/COLUMN and T.15 DIP SW. TEST before it), and starts and stops each operation with Enter, selecting the next with Up. The operation names are read from the DMD's top line in the retained frames. Outputs are polled about every 16 ms, so the per-operation seconds carry that resolution. Each operation window runs from the snapshot before its start press to the snapshot after its stop press (about 0.47 s longer than press to press); each CLOCK STOPPED window covers the four 0.25 s samples after the open or stop press. --handle-mechanics 0 leaves the driver's clock model off, so the clock optos never change and the display stays at 0:00: the run shows which public outputs the ROM drives for each named operation, not which way a motor turns. The run was made into review-artifacts/twilight-zone/clock-test-run2 and the folder was moved to review-artifacts/twilight-zone-1993/clock-test-run2 afterwards, so run.json still records the old work_dir and dmd_dir paths; its dmd-png, dmd-ocr, dmd-topline-png and dmd-topline-ocr folders are frame renders and OCR made after the run, and the canonical manifest pins every file in the moved folder.

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external
source.manifest_algorithm: source.sha256 is the SHA-256 of the run folder's manifest.json exact bytes, written and checked by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py: compact canonical JSON with sorted keys, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, plus one LF, listing every file under source.path except manifest.json and manifest.sha256 as {path, sha256, size} with POSIX relative paths sorted by path; manifest.sha256 beside it holds the same digest.
